title: dictyBase: a community resource for Dictyostelium genomes, genes, and curation
description: A modern reimplementation of the Dictyostelium model-organism database: searchable gene records, 20 sequenced dictyostelid genomes, GO/phenotype/expression data, structures, a genome browser, BLAST, enrichment, and molecular-biology tools. Aggregates and re-presents data from dictyBase (Basu et al. 2015), UniProt, NCBI, EBI, OMA, RCSB, and KEGG. This deposit's MIT license covers the source code and data-build scripts only; the bundled curated data are redistributed under their original source licenses.
